import pandas as pd

# Create a DataFrame with mixed data types
data = {
    'id': ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5'],
    'name': ['Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie', 'Diana', 'Eve'],
    'score': ['85.5', '92.0', 'invalid', '78.3', '88.1'],
    'active': ['True', 'False', 'yes', 'True', 'no']
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert 'id' column to integer type
df['id'] = df['id'].astype(int)

# Convert 'score' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['score'] = pd.to_numeric(df['score'], errors='coerce')

# Standardize 'active' to boolean
def parse_bool(val):
    return val.lower() in ('true', 'yes', '1')

df['active'] = df['active'].apply(parse_bool)

print(df.dtypes)
